medical.candidate_set: R E10, RA E16, RCA E12
medical.interpretation: Mixed selected-checkpoint evidence with epoch-selection confounding; no robust CIR dominance over RA.

proven: Historical H2 identity and replay pass.
The extension has one common E0 and fixed-input parity pass.
R, RA, and RCA training completed under the exact H2 contract; RA and RCA resumed through E20.
Source selection was target-blind and Medical evaluation completed 18 frozen cells.
Only the frozen RA E16 winner was evaluated on MVTec.
correlational: Medical RA-R and RCA-RA rows use source-selected different epochs and are not clean same-epoch causal estimates.
The source-side CIR telemetry proves an active train-time path, not a generalization benefit.
The new R E10 Medical gap versus the historical H2 replay is an observed reproduction/generalization discrepancy, not by itself proof of a code failure.
unknown: A clean same-epoch Medical RCA-vs-RA causal estimate was not run because the preregistered Medical set was source-selected candidates only.
No inference-time alpha comparison was part of this H2 master experiment.
